item.title: Love and Math
item.description: Author: Edward Frenkel (USA) Original title: Love and Math: The Heart of Hidden Reality Publication year: 2016-3 ISBN: 9787508658070 Notes: I finished this book on the high-speed train during a round trip. It is a fairly light, autobiographical kind of mathematics book. It mainly follows the timeline of the author’s schooling, and tells the story of how a boy interested in physics, step by step and through unremitting effort, became a world-class mathematician.

item.title: Fractal Theory
item.description: 1. Fractal Theory 1.1 The Definition of a Fractal A fractal usually refers to a geometric shape that can be divided into several parts, each of which is approximately a reduced-scale copy of the whole — that is, it has the property of self-similarity. 1.2 The History of Fractal Research In the 17th century, Leibniz already pondered the problem of self-similarity.
